text.tspan: DID THE PEOPLE WHO FOUND ONE CHANNEL TALK TO THE PEOPLE WHO DECIDED ABOUT THE
OTHER? THE RECORD DOES NOT SAY. THE BOOK WILL NOT GUESS. A VISIT, RECOGNITION OF THE
ACTIVITY, INTERNAL REPORTING, A DECISION AND PUBLIC DISCLOSURE WOULD BE DIFFERENT
EVENTS. EVIDENCE FOR ONE STEP CANNOT SILENTLY FILL IN THE REST OF THE CHAIN.
